ocrvqa.sampling_order: sorted image_id, then original question index
ocrvqa.prompt: Original question + newline + Answer the question using a single word or phrase.
ocrvqa.metric: Case-insensitive, whitespace-stripped exact match; LLaVA-HR OCRVQAAccuracyEvaluator
ocrvqa.reason: Author confirms random 2000 evaluation instances. Reconstructed from official test QA; original author subset IDs unavailable. Published scores are not an exact same-subset comparison.

gqa.source: Official GQA eval.py, correct=(predicted==gold); LoRASculpt+.pdf section4.1
gqa.reason: Compute the exact reported Accuracy with official questions/answers. Scene graphs/choices only support unreported auxiliary metrics; do not block paper Accuracy.
